text: Mange, ticks, lice, and flies are common external parasites. Their negative impact includes: skin lesions from serious irritation and constant scratching, which slow growth and open the way to other skin infections; blood depletion, since ticks feed only on blood sucked from the animal; annoyance and stress, especially from flies when present in large numbers; and disease transmission — flies contacting feces can carry E. coli, Salmonella, and Coccidiosis; ticks can transmit blood diseases like Babesia and Anaplasma; mosquitoes spread Fowl Pox.
